compiled_state.title: GREEN rename: update validate-config.sh KNOWN_SCALAR_KEYS and all config files
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: max_resolution_attempts key is renamed to max_cycles in all code paths that read or write it — no remaining references to the old key in production code
- DD4: .claude/dso-config.conf sample/default value updated to review.max_cycles

## Overview
Update validate-config.sh and all three config files to use the new key name. These are self-contained text changes with no behavioral logic — existing tests remain valid (GREEN mode).

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/validate-config.sh: modify (KNOWN_SCALAR_KEYS line 155: rename review.max_resolution_attempts → review.max_cycles)
- .claude/dso-config.conf: modify (line 187: rename key; line 197: update comment)
- plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf: modify (line 56: update commented example key)
- plugins/dso/docs/dso-config.example.conf: modify (line 104: update commented example key)

## Implementation

### validate-config.sh (line 155)
Change:
```bash
    review.max_resolution_attempts
```
To:
```bash
    review.max_cycles
```

### .claude/dso-config.conf (lines 184-199)
Change:
- Line 184 comment: "Review resolution — maximum autonomous fix/defend attempts before escalating to the user."
- Line 187: `review.max_resolution_attempts=3` → `review.max_cycles=4`
  (Default changes from 3→4 per epic SC2 specification)
- Line 197 comment: "This key is orthogonal to review.max_resolution_attempts" → "This key is orthogonal to review.max_cycles"

### plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf (line 56)
Change:
`# review.max_resolution_attempts=5` → `# review.max_cycles=4`

### plugins/dso/docs/dso-config.example.conf (line 104)
Change:
`# review.max_resolution_attempts=5` → `# review.max_cycles=4`

## Consumer Detection Pass
validate-config.sh KNOWN_SCALAR_KEYS is the authoritative allowlist. After this task, validate-config.sh will:
- Accept review.max_cycles (new key)
- Flag review.max_resolution_attempts as unknown (this is correct — users should migrate)
The backward-compat shim in read-config.sh (T2) handles runtime fallback for users who have not yet updated their config files. validate-config.sh can flag it as unknown without breaking runtime behavior.

## Codebase Green Invariant
After this task lands, the codebase is green because:
- read-config.sh shim (T2) handles the old key at runtime
- .claude/dso-config.conf now uses the new key, so shim returns new value directly
- validate-config.sh KNOWN_SCALAR_KEYS updated, so validation no longer warns about unknown review.max_cycles
- validate-config.sh will emit an "unknown key" warning if any consumer still sets review.max_resolution_attempts (desired behavior — migration signal)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] .claude/dso-config.conf uses new key
  Verify: grep -q '^review\.max_cycles=' .claude/dso-config.conf
- [ ] .claude/dso-config.conf no longer sets old key
  Verify: ! grep -q '^review\.max_resolution_attempts=' .claude/dso-config.conf
- [ ] validate-config.sh KNOWN_SCALAR_KEYS contains review.max_cycles
  Verify: grep -q 'review\.max_cycles' plugins/dso/scripts/validate-config.sh
- [ ] validate-config.sh KNOWN_SCALAR_KEYS no longer lists old key
  Verify: ! grep -q 'review\.max_resolution_attempts' plugins/dso/scripts/validate-config.sh
- [ ] read-config.sh returns correct value for review.max_cycles from updated config
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh review.max_cycles .claude/dso-config.conf | grep -qE '^[0-9]+$'
- [ ] dso-config.reference.conf uses new key
  Verify: grep -q 'review\.max_cycles' plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf
- [ ] dso-config.example.conf uses new key
  Verify: grep -q 'review\.max_cycles' plugins/dso/docs/dso-config.example.conf

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
